next_question.rationale: A large group of abandonments are labelled “abandoned by system” and there are several app/technical voc themes; this suggests a platform- or device-specific problem (for example Android vs iOS vs web) that prevents users from reaching the “paid and confirmed” step. If one interface converts much worse, we can target engineering fixes or roll back a recent release. I expect to see one platform with materially lower conversion from “requested a consultation” to “paid and confirmed.”
